rows.text: "If we successfully sequence and reconstruct it, we could peer into the cosmic origins from before the Dusk Wars, a primordial truth that not even the Aeons have witnessed."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: ...Other-than-human wisdom? Has this woman gone completely mad?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "Regrettably, the Council of Mundanites rejected my proposal outright, stripping my access to the archives. They have thoroughly disgraced the Guild's sacred tenet that 'knowledge must circulate like currency.'"
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "Word has it that a certain young genius harbors views akin to my own. Therefore, I am not alone. I mount this failure here as a testament, waiting for the day it serves as the monument to my ultimate triumph."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: No wonder she abandoned the Guild to strike out on her own. The IPC possesses limitless funding, bleeding-edge tech...
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: ...And practically non-existent ethics. She gets to do anything she wants.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "Audio log: 'Denisovan' research ape no. F-106. Neural adaptation test, passed."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "Excellent. Now let us see if the 'invitation' successfully reaches its recipient."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "Hah. Using my disciple's corpse as a comms relay. Fascinating. Truly fascinating!"
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "You habitually ignore conventional channels. I was forced to employ more... unorthodox methods, Doctor."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: Dr. Primitive!?
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: "You massacred my apes and ruined my laboratory. What do you want?"
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "Leviathan Essence. An undegraded, fully active sample in substantial quantities."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: " And what will you do with it? Brew a pot of tea? Or perhaps inject it into your spine and savor the sensation of becoming a mountain of meat?"
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "Extract the 'memories' locked within its genetic code. I intend to harness the knowledge that has flowed through its bloodlines for billions of years. It is infinitely more authentic than any ancient text."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "And then? You become a walking leviathan encyclopedia? The Essence will shred your consciousness in a fraction of a second."
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "A single individual may lack the capacity, but the IPC does not. A behemoth forged from hundreds of thousands of star systems, billions of employees, and infinite credits... It feels no fear, suffers no fatigue, and obeys only one overriding directive: to convert the 'impossible' into the 'mass-producible.'"
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "I'm listening."
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "I will compensate your losses a hundredfold. Live testing grounds, pristine genetic samples, and the fatal weaknesses of the Galaxy Rangers... I can provide all of that."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "On Vonwacq, entombed beneath the root system of the ancient Thestang tree, lies a carcass. You will find the Leviathan Essence you seek there."
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "Transmit the coordinates and the extraction protocol."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "The tree is warded by the ceremonial seal of an Aeon, and the surface is crawling with Vonwacq sentinels. Your hurdles will be far more than just technical."
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "I will handle it. You only need to deliver the Essence to my designated star system once you receive the first shipment of reconstruction resources."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: " We have a deal. Though, Yabuli..."
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "Yes?"
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "Just so you are aware, this grand prize you are moving half the IPC to acquire? It is the exact side-project Ruan Mei casually dissected and tossed in the trash years ago. Does she make you jealous?"
rows.speaker: Denisovan F-106

rows.text: "That is outside your concern. The deal is struck."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: What a massive blood debt. Yours, mine, everyone's.
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: "Audio log: Family Hominidae, genus Homo. Following cleaning and recombination, the genetic material of test subject λ-032 has been cloned to its 3,904th generation..."
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Just listening to that is giving me a migraine. Just leave her to it.
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: The trail is cold here. Let's go see if our other "detective" dug up anything.
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: How are things going on your end?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Thousands of experiment logs detailing human trials, utterly choked with technical jargon and specialized terminology.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Modern science finds really creative ways to punish anyone who slacked off in school.
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: Fortunately, modern science also provides an elegant workaround. IPC Wolf, give me a clean summary.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Copy. All for the Amber Lord!"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: ...I genuinely feel sorry for that girl.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "Parsing 2,329 log entries..."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "All compatibility trials ended in failure... I had no choice but to solicit aid from ▀▄▄▜..."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "The Guild is practically mine... I have exhumed the theoretical framework of the 'School of Evolutionary Perfection'..."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "By grafting Abundance flesh... the imagenae of Planarcadia..."
rows.speaker: Yabuli

rows.text: "Parsing complete. Three core intelligence tags have been generated. Which file would you like to open first?"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "Leviathan Essence"
"School of Evolutionary Perfection"
"Planarcadia and Imagenae"
That's enough.
What exactly is this Leviathan Essence?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "Given the context, it is a living protoplasm extracted from leviathan remains. It retains active genetic data and serves as the physical storage drive for their cosmic wisdom."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: But leviathans are all dead. How is Yabuli supposed to read that data?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "She opted for biological processors. This included human participants, genetically modified primates, and synthetic neural tissue."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "However, all her trials failed. In her final attempt, the test subject maintained lucid consciousness for a mere 4.2 seconds before collapsing into a lump of organic matter."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: The "School of Evolutionary Perfection"... Isn't that an ideological relic from the Scholars' Strife?
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: "Affirmative. The school has been functionally extinct for eras. The individual referenced in the logs, 'Marcus Antali,' is its final known inheritor."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "The school's core thesis is the 'perfect scholar': an entity possessing an infinite lifespan, capable of deciphering absolutely any knowledge structure. This perfectly aligns with Yabuli's end goals."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "Quoting directly from the source log: 'By utilizing Abundance flesh as the base structure, the organism achieves near-limitless environmental resistance, evolutionary ceiling, and cognitive elasticity. It becomes the flawless receptacle for Leviathan Essence.'"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: So she tried to turn this "perfect scholar" into a lab instrument?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Correct. The annotation for Experiment No. 441 states: 'If the beast's intellect cannot be comprehended, then the mechanism for reading it must be overhauled. I require a vessel resilient enough to bridge the gap between human and leviathan.'"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: Then how exactly did Planarcadia and the imagenae get dragged into this mess?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "The logs indicate that Yabuli's research hit a complete standstill after successive catastrophic failures. The project was only formally resurrected when the Marketing Development Department discovered the planet Ahatopia."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "While on Ahatopia, Yabuli studied the indigenous entities classified as 'imagenae.' She hypothesized that organisms possessing a physical state yet malleable by consciousness were the 'ideal neural interface material.'"
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: So she pivoted to Planarcadia?
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: "Affirmative. A massive sequence of consecutively numbered files has been scrubbed from the database. Reverse-engineering the remaining metadata tags reveals that Yabuli initiated research into Wishpower roughly fifteen years ago."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: "Five years ago, that research achieved a critical breakthrough. Through a singular experiment, Abundance flesh, Leviathan Essence, and imagenated life were perfectly synthesized."
rows.speaker: IPC Wolf

rows.text: That's enough.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Back when we were hunting the second-generation Herald of Death, you asked me a question.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Will you stop me, or will you stand by and watch?"
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Now you can have my answer: Do it. Do what you do best.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I thought you'd keep your cool all the way to the end.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm surprised that your professional mask slips the moment a personal grudge enters the fray.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We're not the only ones seeking vengeance. You're right there with us.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You can't help bringing up the Leviathan Essence, because in a way, it's the remains of your ancestors. Yet Yabuli shamelessly stole it from under your nose.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: For the record, under Article Eight of the Faekind Protection Act (Fifth Edition)...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: ...What's that sound?
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: Ugh, forget it...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Now that you've figured it out, I'll drop the act. No need to burn more calories than necessary.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Vengeance? Certainly. But more importantly...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I'm exercising far more restraint than you could possibly imagine. I am so... hungry.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Do you have any idea of the sheer torture it is for a leviathan's descendant to stand surrounded by Essence potent enough to tempt Oroboros THEMSELF?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Now, let's go carve up Yabuli together. You claim your vengeance, I satiate my appetite, and everyone walks away happy.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I will have my vengeance. But not today.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Yabuli surgically integrated herself into Astropolis as its Artificial Phantasmoon. The moment she dies, every imagenae in the city dies with her.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Fortunately... I don't care about any of that.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: If you really didn't care, you would never have spent the last decade as a Security Officer for us humans.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So, what are you going to do? Will you stop me, or stand by and watch?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: That entirely depends on your next move.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'd hate to break the tension here...
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: But did neither of you notice that the production line just went dead?
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: Dead?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The Essence pipeline... stopped flowing?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Look at the monitors...
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: "Warning. Warning."
rows.speaker: "IPC Wolf"

rows.text: "Essence injection levels supplying Madam Yabuli... catastrophic anomalies detected!"
rows.speaker: "IPC Wolf"

rows.text: ...We are too late.
rows.speaker: "Narrator"

rows.text: It's Ashveil, isn't it? I knew those two weren't involved.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: They were in the dark, too.
They were blindsided, too.
Then, there's only one possibility left.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It was me.
I did it. All of it.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Lighthouse? What are you doing here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Your emotions... they feel like a storm. Churning, raging, and so sad.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: What exactly did you do to Yabuli?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: She succeeded. She got the answer she was looking for.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: And I will finally find... release. In the end, we both get what we wanted.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: If you want the truth, go down and see for yourself.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Let's go, [Trailblazer]. We don't have time to waste.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Just "release," huh?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Lighthouse, is this ending enough for you?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Ah... the deliverer from beyond the stars. My executioner. Just how much longer until you arrive?
Asat Pramad's Die. Why is it here?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Long time no see, "Protagonist".
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: We have Yabuli's insatiable thirst for knowledge to thank for this little reunion.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Is this your doing?
What happened to her?
Of course... not. But it is a fortunate turn of events.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Her mind is blown!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Oh, two more just showed up. Looks like everyone's here now.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Wake up, Madam Yabuli! Time to receive our guests!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Ha... hahaha! The ancient blood sings!
rows.speaker: Crazed Voice

rows.text: Don't digest that star... the primordial star! And the eyes!
rows.speaker: Crazed Voice

rows.text: What is that floating in the vat?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That has to be... Yabuli.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ▄█ABN▀█▄▀ORMAL▄▄
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: My apologies for arriving empty-handed.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Rumor has it the Director of the Technology Department is a young lady...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I never expected "young" to mean she was still just a brain.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: The sentiment is mutual. I have dissected more brains than I can count, but yours would be the crown jewel of my collection.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Never judge a book by its cover. Save your awe for when you finally crack it open.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I intend to. It is just a pity that the specific "knowledge" I require is not currently residing in your cranium.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Is that supposed to be a joke?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Your physical body is currently light-years away, and the Voracity has not yet fully digested it. Theoretically, you are still actively receiving its neural signals.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: I will be borrowing your brain to gaze into the belly of the husk.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: You have it all figured out. I assume this is not your first rodeo?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Operating on a Lord Ravager? That is a first.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Before I surrendered myself to the Destruction, I was at least considered a "Starseer." To think I have now been reduced to a glorified endoscope for the IPC.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Very well. It's not as if I have any pressing engagements elsewhere.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Synchronization rate: 89 percent... 96 percent...
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: You will be fully reacquainted with your body in a matter of seconds. How does it feel?
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Like trying to recall the face of someone you forgot an eternity ago.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Connection fully established. Commencing data transfer.
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: I cannot see a thing. Did your grand experiment fail?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Spare me the transparent lies. Your prefrontal lobe is firing far more honestly than your tongue.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Fine, I can see it. Pulverized appendages, silver rails, amber, black holes... everywhere. A single meal for Oroboros is the entire universe.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: THEY have never known satiation, and THEY never will. Even in death, THEIR rotting carcass continues to gorge.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Hah, there is another severed head floating up ahead. Let me see which poor sap this is...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: ...Who? You? I? How... How is this possible...?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: This must be a joke. Ha... haha...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Why are you laughing? What did you see!?
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Son of a... just kill me! Why...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Why is it YOUR head!?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: He isn't acting. Has his psyche shattered? But that's impossible.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Exactly! It is impossible! This thing vanished hundreds of Amber Eras ago! How could it possibly be floating here!?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Unless... Unless! Yabuli! There is only one explanation!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Mastaka, upload his visual feed. Do it now!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Ma'am, the synchronization link has been lost.
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: It was you? You manually severed the connection to your own body.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: ...I apologize for my loss of composure just now. But I'm afraid I have to keep this little secret to myself.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Hilarious, is it not? I believed I was eliminated from the board. Reduced to a severed head, waiting to be swept into the incinerator like common garbage.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: But what I just witnessed changes everything.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Aha made absolute fools of us all. The curse of "Elation" still has me pinned firmly to this chessboard.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I don't care about your pathetic games! Mastaka, Lighthouse, send in the sweepers. Carve whatever he saw right out of his gray matter.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: You didn't have to die today. What a pity.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Allow me to perform a little magic trick for you, Yabuli. Let's see what the severed head of a Lord Ravager is truly capable of.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Lighthouse. Do it.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Out of curiosity, how long have you been working for her?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Five years. Without a single misstep. And today will be no exception.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Tell me... did you ever stop to wonder why it has been exactly five years?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Nineteen eighty-four.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: What are you talking about?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Don't listen to a single word he says!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Dovebrook District. The Academy.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Ugh...!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: The blackboard bulletin. The paint.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Stop it. Make it stop!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: What are you waiting for? I gave you an order. Kill him!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: The Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Enough!!!
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Lighthouse, what are you doing!?
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Don't rush the poor man. He's simply going through what I went through. He's remembering a name he forgot an eternity ago...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: The Herald of Death. Marcus Antali.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Five years ago, the IPC executed the mastermind behind the Bloodstained Games. Coincidence or not, it was the Technology Department that sealed the requisition form to transfer his corpse.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: The scheming party genuinely believed they had scrubbed the memories clean from Shuhu's flesh. They were oblivious to the fact that those memories were simply absorbed by the Leviathan Essence inside Lighthouse.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Honestly, Yabuli, I should thank you. By linking my consciousness to the husk, you provided me the exact frequency needed to awaken his slumbering desire.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: The bloody raw materials... the grotesque experiments... I followed every order you gave. I managed this production line with absolute, unwavering loyalty. But...
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Why did you hide the truth from me, Madam Yabuli?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Why would you let a mass murderer live out the fantasy of being a hero... for five whole years!?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Because she has something to hide herself.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Fifteen years ago, when Shuhu's cells first leaked into Planarcadia, a certain high-ranking executive caught wind of it immediately. But instead of sounding the alarm, she chose to let the currents carry the contagion.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: She gave you the final push right into the abyss, creating the Herald of Death.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: How did you know?
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: ...Ah... Hahaha! Asat Pramad! I finally see it! You were the one who swapped that reagent with Shuhu's cells in the first place!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Lighthouse, open your eyes and look at him! Look at who truly deserves to burn in hell! Do not let him use you as a weapon!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Shh... Let the man decide for himself.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: ...Both of you deserve to burn.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: What? Lighthouse, you cannot forget... Ugh! Argh...!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: No! Marcus! What did you just do!?
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: A splitting headache? Perfect. He merely entertained a fleeting little thought.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: And miles beneath us underground, his clone turned a tiny dial.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: And just like that, Astropolis's supply of Leviathan Essence comes swarming into your tiny little brain.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: ...You're next.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Of course. I fully respect your right to vengeance. Be my guest.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: No. I will not kill you. I cannot kill you. Even death is meaningless to a creature like you.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: And my vengeance against Yabuli is not the result of your manipulation. I did it because she deserved it.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Did you truly believe that resurrecting the memories of the Herald of Death would turn me back into that monster?
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Farewell, Lord Ravager. I'm leaving to do what I must.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: ...Assuming I still have the right to do so.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Well now... Look at that, Yabuli. The masquerade is officially over.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: It's abundantly clear who passed the challenge, and who did not.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Tell me, would you classify this as a wish come true?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I see it now... I knew it all along...
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: The abdominal cavity... The sneers... The fragmented cognition...
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Budding reproduction... shattering the shell... returning to the origin... The warm, suffocating dark!
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: This overgrown dandelion of a brain... is Yabuli?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: While we were busy digging for clues, someone beat us to the punch and assassinated our {RUBY_B#Yabuli}culprit{RUBY_E#}?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: She got what she deserved.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: That thing is Yabuli?
She doesn't look like she's doing too well...
Ashveil, what happened on your end?
Correct. That's her brain. She remodeled herself into a Phantasmoon.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Perhaps we should ask the primary suspect in the room.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It's a long story. We'll catch you up later.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I knew it was you. What did I say?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: You ruin every party you crash.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If we let Yabuli continue with her transformation, she's going to swallow Astropolis whole.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: But by killing her, the consequences would be just as unthinkable.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I'm absolutely fascinated to see how you handle this.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Why? I finally have the answer, yet I feel no satisfaction...
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: Yabuli is destined to die today. The only difference is how it happens.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Let me be really clear. If we destroy this Artificial Phantasmoon, every imagenae in Astropolis dies with it.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: And let me be really clear. I don't care.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Mastaka... I'm so hungry... I'm starving...
rows.speaker: Brain in a Vat: Yabuli

rows.text: " Starving, starving, starving, starving, starving, starving, starving!"
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: Are we too late after all?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We have another life-or-death decision. [Trailblazer], what's your call?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: We need to stay alert...
If it comes down to it, I won't hesitate.
There has to be another way out of this.
Whatever choice you make, commit to it. See it through to the end.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: That's the only way you survive in a den of beasts.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "I can smell it! The sisters... the shadows... and..."
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: " But it doesn't matter. No one is escaping. I saw THEM, and I witnessed exactly what THEY saw..."
rows.speaker: Mastaka

rows.text: Every last one, reduced to slabs of meat!
rows.speaker: ??? Yabuli

rows.text: Seems like morality has trapped our Ranger.
Let me call the shots.
Haha... And who might you be?
What a surprise... A delicious treat!
I'm really looking forward to devouring your joy!
Please lend me "a hand."
Little Raccoon, come over here!
It's time for the "shadow" to shine.
Well, you should know the price you might have to pay...
Remains that fell into shadow, crouching beast that lay eternally awake...
Oroboros, swallow your offspring!
Haven't had such a hearty meal in a long time...
...Brings back memories.
[Trailblazer], are you alright?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That was close.
Thanks, I'm fine.
I got hungry watching that.
Thanks to you, I enjoyed my first proper meal in a long time.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Yabuli dies, and all imagenae in Astropolis will vanish too. While the resurrected Herald of Death gets to walk away scot-free.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: ...We certainly did our "due diligence."
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: [Trailblazer], please grab the imagenae and fall back to Planarcadia immediately. Save as many as you can. I'll clean up the rest of this mess...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Don't be so dramatic. I've told you time and again: I don't care about your human dilemmas...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Because they're so easy to solve.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Astropolis needs a human-beast chimera to regulate the Essence?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: You've got one right here.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Who are you talking about?
What, you mean yourself?
...You?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You're going to get in that incubator and be the new Phantasmoon?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You know what will happen. The IPC's cleanup crew will be here any second, followed closely by a pack of lunatics with even lower moral bars than Yabuli.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Every inhumane experiment you can possibly imagine will be lining up at your door. They won't treat you like a person. They'll just treat you like a...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Like a "beast," right?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I've lived in Planarcadia for over a millennium. Putting that past aside, my years serving as a Security Officer alone were enough to teach me one thing.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I may have the blood of a leviathan running through my veins, but I am far more deserving of being called human than most of the scum in this universe.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: This is the kind of sacrifice a "human" makes, Detective.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: I... you...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I refuse to accept this kind of sacrifice!
Hold on, there has to be another way.
Nihilux, you're supposed to be an Ae... a cosmically renowned artist! Think of something, quick!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You know, "resurrection" isn't exactly part of the public's stereotype of the Elation...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: To conjure a miracle of that magnitude, one must pay an exceptionally steep price.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I'll stop believing in you if you can't do it.
Can't you just draw another moon?
I'll pay the price! Take my belly button!
"No, that's no fun at all."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If "Aha" were standing here, that's probably what THEY'd say. But the ever-gracious Blurry_QR_Colt wouldn't mind performing one more magic trick for you...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Miss Kuchiba, there's no rush to take off that mask just yet. The party isn't quite over yet.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Remember? This is Astropolis, and the people here have their own heroes.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Am I just that exhausted? I can't catch my breath...
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Beep boop, my eyes... are blurry...
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: Furbulitzer, what's wrong with you guys?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The Wishpower in Astropolis suddenly disappeared!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: It hurts... my whole body hurts! Lighthouse, where's Lighthouse? Somebody help us, please!
rows.speaker: Terrified Lightpaw

rows.text: I'm sleepy. I can't keep my eyes open... I just want to sleep.
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Oh no, whatever you do, don't close your eyes!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I should have never come to Astropolis...
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Don't worry, little guy. You're going to live.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Someone was calling for "Lighthouse," so... here I am.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Number 144.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Lighthouse, is this ending enough for you?
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: ...You have the wrong person. I'm the "Herald of Death," Marcus Antali.
rows.speaker: Self in the Memory

rows.text: And now, I'm going to make sure {RUBY_B#every Lighthouse}this murderer{RUBY_E#} faces the {RUBY_B#death}judgment{RUBY_E#} he deserves.
rows.speaker: Self in the Memory

rows.text: It's Lighthouse! Save me! Mr. Lighthouse!
rows.speaker: Terrified Lightpaw

rows.text: Number 145.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: But I think you have another choice.
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: Not looking back at the past, but... turning to the now.
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: Lighthouse! It's Lighthouse...
rows.speaker: Frail Lightpaw

rows.text: ...Number 146.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I knew you'd come to save us...
rows.speaker: Frail Lightpaw

rows.text: Here are three masks: Marcus of the Guild, Herald of Death from the Arcadia, and...
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: Now, pick the one you truly want, and put it on.
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: I am...
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Lighthouse of Astropolis.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: I feel... warm...
rows.speaker: Frail Lightpaw

rows.text: Someone told me that this is how we can "exchange" Wishpower.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: This will sustain the imagenae around for long enough until THEY complete THEIR mission and grant you all new life.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: But... your body...
rows.speaker: Frail Lightpaw

rows.text: If you keep going, you...
rows.speaker: Frail Lightpaw

rows.text: Don't sweat it. Win some, lose some. Simple math. At least in this moment, I'm doing exactly what I want to do.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: The time has finally come to return the {RUBY_B#life taken from the others}Wishpower I borrowed from you all{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Under the light of "Lighthouse," live on with a smile.
rows.speaker: Lighthouse

rows.text: Why give me this chance?
rows.speaker: Self in the Memory

rows.text: Marcus Antali was a wretched murderer. No matter how much he tries to make amends, {RUBY_B#my}his{RUBY_E#} sins can never be washed clean.
rows.speaker: Self in the Memory

rows.text: Throughout my long life, I've seen many things capable of changing a person: love, journeys, memories... even one simple mask.
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: But none of that matters. What truly matters is...
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: I believe that a person can change.
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: And right now, Astropolis has hundreds of "Lighthouses"...
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: More than enough to change the fate of this world.
rows.speaker: Voice in the Memory

rows.text: Long time no see, Ms. Yabuli. I'm glad to see you're still breathing.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You know what you've done...
rows.speaker: Dying Yabuli

rows.text: Openly murdering an executive on IPC turf...
rows.speaker: Dying Yabuli

rows.text: I deeply regret this tragedy. The Strategic Investment Department will not rest until the killer is brought to justice.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: If I die, the secrets of Astropolis will see the light of day...
rows.speaker: Dying Yabuli

rows.text: You won't be able to... stay above the fray...
rows.speaker: Dying Yabuli

rows.text: I am profoundly heartbroken by your death and any collateral damage it may cause.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: However, my time in the Arcadia has taught me a great deal, enough for me to draw a new conclusion.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: My title as one of the "Ten Stonehearts" means nothing to me, while it means a lot to all of us to see you dead.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The accused, Yabuli, you were indirectly responsible for two Herald of Death incidents and attempted the vivification of Ahatopia. Pursuant to Article 129 of the Arcadia Management Regulations, I hereby pass sentence in the name of the CEO...
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Ms. Yabuli, please, kindly die.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: So be it...
rows.speaker: Dying Yabuli

rows.text: I've already seen the truth anyway.
rows.speaker: Dying Yabuli

rows.text: And with that, after fifteen long years...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: The Herald of Death case is officially closed.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Long time no see, [Trailblazer]. Glad to see you're still in one piece.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: This is a pre-recorded message. I believe the Astral Express can find the variable in Astropolis that will decide the course of the battle.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: I thought it was you in the flesh.
We didn't let you down.
The "variable" is standing right next to me.
I'll do everything in my power to suppress the husk's activity until you hit your target.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: When the time comes, activate the transmitter. I'll lock onto its coordinates and pull you back to the arcadia.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Looks like the other side is ready, too.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: We still have a few unanswered questions... but how about we get out of here first?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Otherwise, trouble's going to come knocking on our door again.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: ...Thank goodness someone bailed us out.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: But who put Lighthouse up to this?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: The answer is pretty obvious...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: But let's wait for her to say it herself.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: So you're saying they survived because Lighthouse sacrificed himself...?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And wait, Yabuli turned into a leviathan and you fought her? But if she absorbed all the Leviathan Essence, and now she's dead...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then where are we supposed to find more "bait" for the Voracity?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ah, I totally forgot about that.
Actually... I wanted to ask that...
Since you're a leviathan too... do you regurgitate?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Drop it. The second that Leviathan Essence was injected, that option went out the window.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: ...Feels like a huge bombshell just drifted by. Never mind, I'm not even going to ask...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer], quick, think of something!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Forget it, we'll just wait for death to come knocking.
We have to find a replacement.
Nihilux, quick, think of something!
Ugh, seriously? More of this nonsense? This really isn't the time for jokes!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: How about you just drop me down there?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Let's try to think of another way.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...There is one other option, though I was really hoping to avoid it.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Die, stop playing dumb.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Ahh! How did that get here!? Almost gave me a heart attack!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Ol' Die, when did you get here?
Are you the gum stuck on the bottom of my shoe?
Cut the nonsense and spit it out.
It was lying right in front of the vat. I didn't want it to cause any more trouble, so I scooped it up.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Do you want me to be? I can arrange that.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: What's the rush? You could at least allow the former Navigator a little pageantry.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: I'm sure you all remember that my body was swallowed by "the Voracity" not too long ago.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: But right now, this severed head and that body are still naturally drawn to each other... What does that mean? It means you have the perfect bait.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: You old Die, what shady scheme are you plotting this time?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Oh, I'm merely assisting in a grand performance.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: You can't expect pearls of wisdom from that thing, but it isn't wrong. As bait, it's just as potent as the Leviathan Essence... maybe even more targeted.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: At this point, we don't exactly have a Plan B.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I gave Arita a heads-up to clear out the bottom floor of Skycall Aery for us. It'll make contacting Pearl much easier.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Let's tie up any loose ends before we head out.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: If I'm not mistaken, everything played out exactly as you anticipated.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Now we have no option but to give you a role in the final act.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I could say the same to you. How far along is your little performance?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: What performance?
You two sound like you're in cahoots...
Stupid Die. We should wrap you up in a rag.
For the benefit of our young friend here, we should probably spell it out. [Trailblazer], it's time for the crowd pleaser: the grand payoff.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: A certain someone has been lurking behind the scenes from the very beginning, using a comic to stockpile a massive reservoir of Wishpower for you. She's also the one who led the eight Supplicants into this game, one by one.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Oh wow, wonder who could that be?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And you, hoping to borrow the IPC's power to suppress the husk, came to Astropolis. What a coincidence that this place harbored the perfect bait to reel in the Voracity, as well as the final two survivors of the Bloodstained Games.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Then, with the gentlest of nudges, she ensured a certain die fell right into the hands of the poor, pathetic Yabuli.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Yabuli could have lived. I gave her a choice.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: It may seem like you took the scenic route, but you never actually strayed from the mission. Gathering the Supplicants, amassing the Wishpower... it was all just setting the stage for the final Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: All eyes across the cosmos will be fixed on Ahatopia to witness this god-slaying game.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: My dear lady, did things turn out just as you wished?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: So far, more or less. It all hinges on what happens next, and whether it's my favorite kind of happy ending.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Then I shall keep the spoilers to myself. We have to leave a little suspense for the audience watching at home.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: But I am genuinely curious how you plan to deliver on your biggest setup of all: "No longer just for a fleeting minute, but to become the true permanent Aeon of Elation."
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: You'll see. I promise.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And when that moment arrives, even Enroute, who has heard a trillion jokes, is guaranteed to laugh out loud.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: I wait with bated breath.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Now that the actors are all in position...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: [Trailblazer], shall we get moving?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: We didn't even get a chance to thank that big guy, Lighthouse!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Lighthouse's Wishpower is limited, we need to conserve our energy until we can get home and find a permanent cure for Astropolis.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: President... are you guys leaving? I... I want to go back too! We can't let the arcadia get eaten!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Beep boop, is this the part where we pledge our loyalty? Then, President, I...! I'm still scared.
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: Furbulitzer, your voice is shaking.
Paraprince, say goodbye to your bonus this month.
Are the rest of the little furbos doing alright?
It is not! I just caught a little cold.
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Beep boop, we never had a bonus to begin with.
rows.speaker: Paraprince

rows.text: They're all eagerly awaiting your good news, President!
rows.speaker: Furbulitzer

rows.text: Mister N is done cleaning up the mess at the illegal factory.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You're leaving without saying goodbye to him?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Say goodbye, and then drag him along to deal with that ancestor of yours?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: I've already sorted things out with the furbos. They'll look after Mister N for me. The cash under the fridge should last him a good while.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: By the time he finds out, it'll be too late for him to chew me out.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Madam, the signal amplifiers are fully online. We can establish a comms link with Planarcadia at your command.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: The camera permissions for Interastral Peace Entertainment have also been cleared, exactly as Miss March requested.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Father is buried in work and couldn't make it in person. He asked me to pass along a message: "I hope you make a little less of a splash the next time you visit."
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: That depends on my mood next time.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Much appreciated.
rows.speaker: Kenneth

rows.text: Spatial readings show no anomalies. The comms signal is stable.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Routing the signal to the World in Canvas... complete.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Given my projections, I was fully prepared for this operation to span multiple Amber Eras.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Your swift victory is a pleasant surprise to us all.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: How are things on your end?
What's the Voracity's current status?
How are Himeko and the others holding up?
Thanks to the Supplicants' intervention and the residents of the arcadia banding together, the number of casualties differed little from the lowest end of the projected range.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But, the corrosion from the husk is still systematically devouring our living space.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Ever since the Amber Lord sealed Ahatopia, the husk has fallen into an unnatural stagnation. However, I suspect this isn't a slumber, but rather a dormant phase right before a feeding frenzy.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The Nameless are currently resting in the shelter. They are concerned about [Trailblazer] and Miss March.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: The only variable I failed to calculate was the architect of this plan: the leader of the Mourning Actors, a comic artist known to absolutely everyone in Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: And did you buy it?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That is irrelevant. Out of all the viable strategies, your proposal had the highest probability of success.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: And Mr. Ashveil, you are a truly exceptional detective. I am authorizing a fifty percent increase to your final payout.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Hold on a second. The detective isn't quite finished with his deductions.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: You dispatched us to Astropolis under the guise of retrieving the Essence. You knew perfectly well that the moment Yabuli's secret came to light, either Kuchiba or I would kill her.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Knowing you, you likely have a dozen contingency plans tucked away. But I'm not curious about your methods. I'm curious about your motive.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: This assassination wasn't handed down by your superiors. It was your decision. Why?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Planarcadia bled heavily for this game. Don't you think the other culprit, alongside Asat Pramad, should be forced to pay the toll?
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Even if the cost is declaring war on other IPC departments? Even if it costs you your rank? Is it really worth it?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: There was a time when I believed deciphering art and managing the arcadia were one and the same, yet in the end, I understood neither.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Until yesterday, when the children in the shelter gifted me a drawing. It is crude. It is monotonous. But in my eyes, it's more precious than the greatest masterpiece.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Mr. Ashveil, this is what it's all about.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: And the only thing I can offer them in return is justice.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: No. You can also offer them victory.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Besides, didn't Asat Pramad strike the killing blow against Yabuli?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Not long ago, a colleague wished me a fruitful harvest here in Planarcadia.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Even now, my logic circuits are incapable of defining perfect art.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: But I no longer need to compensate for that four percent margin of error. Masterstroke or misstep... every color I add and every brushstroke I lay down holds genuine meaning.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: It is not an imitation, nor is it an original creation. There is no right, and there is no wrong.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: And that's exactly where its value lies.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Seems like everything's in place.
In that case, I shall use my body as a paintbrush
to complete a true "creation."
I come to appraise.
I come to analyze.
I come to render.
I weave the cosmos into brocade.
Breathe soul into painted stones, let the jewels of heaven rise as they will.
On behalf of all residents in Planarcadia, thank you for everything you've done.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Just doing my job.
Everyone did all that they could for this world.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Including General Yao Guang, who's vanished due to Temporal Dislocation. Unfortunately, we still haven't been able to re-establish contact with her.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: She'll be back. Just have faith in the will of The Hunt.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: March, let the others know you're safe.
We finally made it back. You should probably let everyone know you're safe and sound.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: How am I even supposed to explain the whole "baiting the Voracity" thing? You know what, whatever. We've cleaned up plenty of messes before. I'm sure this one will be fine, too.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'll leave it to you, then.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Speaking of which, where is Miss Kuchiba?
The Security Officer didn't come back with us?
She has no reason to fight the husk to the bitter end, nor does she have any reason to make enemies out of us.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: So, until the dust settles, she opted to steer clear.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Before she left, she asked me to pass this message along...
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Leaving without a word, huh? How are you getting out of here? Ship or shuttle?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Nothing that luxurious. I'm walking home, Detective.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "You seem to be in a good mood."
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "Of course I am. I just had a massive feast. I won't have to worry about going hungry for months."
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Way to play it down. You could have ended up eating all your meals in IPC prison canteens. Willingly walking into that cage to save someone else? What were you thinking?"
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "I'm fond of humans, that's it."
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: True, humans make for terrible food. But...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: These unpalatable humans are capable of creating delicious "Elation."
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: For long-lived leviathans, the "aftertaste" is infinitely more important than momentary satisfaction.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: So, only by reining in your desires and putting on a mask... can you claim to truly enjoy "Voracity."
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "But if you let that hunger consume you instead, even a human can devolve into a beast. Just like Yabuli."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: You managed to reach me. I guess I haven't walked far enough?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Logic dictates that you are still within the coverage area of the Interastral Peace Network."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Pearl, you were planning to use me as your trump card from the very beginning, weren't you? What a ruthless Intellitron.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Yet you will not face arrest. Projection: There is a high probability that Ashveil will call upon the Galaxy Rangers..."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: "Give me a break. As long as {RUBY_B#One-Eyed Owl}that woman{RUBY_E#} has her eyes on me, I could never pull that off. Looks like even your calculations can be off sometimes, huh?"
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: "I'm only learning: to speculate from a human perspective."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Heh, you really have changed, Pearl.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Someone once told me, "After a story comes to a close, after all material gains and losses are accounted for, the thing that seems to spring into being from nothing at all... is the most precious treasure."
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Perhaps you're close to finding it.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: It's about time I get going. Take care of yourselves. And Ashveil, I hope you get your wish and die of old age in your own bed.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "Well, that was a little too blunt."
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Pearl, I hope you discover true art.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: "I will. My 'pearl' is right here, beating within the 'heart' of this shell."
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: Lastly, pass on a warning to the remaining Supplicants for me.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Remember Yabuli's crazed ravings down at the bottom of the Life Sciences Institute?
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: It almost felt like that was the "ancestor" THEMSELF speaking.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Are you saying the Voracity's husk has been awake this whole time?
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: Whether it's the lingering ravings of a corpse or a living consciousness... I'm not sure.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: A hundred thousand years have passed. leviathans are not as immutable as you all imagine.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: After all, even a leviathan descendant like me has learned to savor Elation. If my ancestor is anything like me...
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: ...Well, to the actors off to slay the vicious beast... I wish you the best of luck.
rows.speaker: Kuchiba

rows.text: Pearl and the others went to handle the remaining preparations. Before the actors take the stage, we have one last thing to do.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: This game is still missing one critical element. Care to guess what it is?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The answer: a referee.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: She poured every ounce of her strength into sustaining the Ambrosial Arbor, and descended into a deep slumber. So the Fox Mask was also disqualified. She did incredibly well... truly worthy of being the arbitrator of the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: But honestly, even I have decided to take the field. There's no way I'm letting her sit this one out alone.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: [Trailblazer], it's time to go wake Evanefox up.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Of course. I can't wait.
Can you pull that off?
Which version of her will we wake up?
The one you know, of course.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Remember the "backdoor" she left for you? That mask covered in those awful scribbles.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That silly little fox. Trying to pull a fast one right under my nose and thinking she wouldn't get caught.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Kind people deserve to be treated with kindness. That mask granted you the right to "join the game." Are you willing to return that Supplicant's destiny to her, so your little fan may come back?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Relax, I'm way better at creating backdoors than she is. I'll whip up a new mask for you in no time.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: That works.
Let's go. She's going to be absolutely thrilled when she wakes up and sees us.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And so, the pact is sealed.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Evanescia, answer me.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Phantasmoon above, Elwood below.
Phantasmoon above and Elwood below, witness this oath at this moment. As constant as the vault of heaven, as certain as the moon's rise, let it be never forsworn.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Welcome back.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: You've been on quite a few grand adventures while I was asleep, little raccoon!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Nescia, I missed you so much!
The title of Supplicant, a gift from the mask in return.
Come along with us on the adventure this time.
...It's been thousands of years. This is the first time anyone has ever given me a gift like this.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Hmm... A return gift, a return gift... Darn it, I left all my treasures back in the Demonhold... Wait, I got it!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I'll give you my dazzling smile in return! Hehe.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: That's more than enough.
That's not quite enough, is it?
Hehe, it's the best gift ever.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Is that so? I guess I have no choice but to part with my precious treasure... I'll give you the collector's edition comic I've cherished for two thousand years.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Yeah, you can keep that.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I know, right!? It's the best gift ever.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: From the very first page of The Fluffy, Volume 1, Chapter 1, I knew you would open a whole new book in the arcadia.
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Now, it's finally time for the invincible Evanefox to make her entrance! I'll do everything I can to give the Planarcadia arc a perfect ending!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Hey, let's not forget about me.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Oh my goodness, we even have Blurry_QR_Colt here in the flesh!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ...Huh?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Who? I? H—How is this possible...?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: ...It's "you"!? You're the... the... the...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Looks like you aren't completely out of it. So, do you remember who you are?
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Of course. I'm referee of the game, witness to the "Elation."
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The husk resurrects, and the hero returns. At this life-or-death juncture, we revisit the place where it all began, to reconnect the threads of cause and effect...
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: And then... we turn this farce into a festival! A long-overdue Aeonic game!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: Let's go. Consider it a bit of fan service for our little fox friend.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Hear that? The referee is in place, and it's time for the Supplicants to make their entrance.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: A thousand Amber Eras ago, Aha and the gods rode on a gondola to hunt down the ancient leviathan.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Later, THEY raised the moon and shed a single tear, and tricked eight Actors. They gathered beneath this very tree, to imprison the most terrifying of things with the most ridiculous of games.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: And today, we set sail once more! To deceive! To bait! To slay! The awakened... Oroboros!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Stay tuned: alongside the Supplicants, an Aeon will personally take the stage to vie for the victor's crown. These will be the grandest Phantasmoon Games in the arcadia's history yet.
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Now, time to decide: walk away... or step forward!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Only a total lunatic would agree to a suicide mission like this. If I sat this one out, it'd be an insult to Aha, wouldn't it?
rows.speaker: Sparxie

rows.text: Let's bring laughter to the people, in waking reality.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Elio said not to lose to Aha. So for this round, I'm gonna one-shot THEM.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I promised Silver Wolf I'd play a round with her. Might as well be this one.
rows.speaker: Blade

rows.text: At this moment, "Preservation" and "Imagenesis" have finally merged into a single theme.
rows.speaker: Pearl

rows.text: To set the Aeon's game right, this Supplicant will offer up everything.
rows.speaker: Ashveil

rows.text: What do you say, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: I will protect this world.
It's time for the hunt.
This is going to be a sleepless night.
As always, for the cosmos and Planarcadia...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: It's time to hunt an Aeon...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Everyone, open your eyes wide. This is going to be a sleepless night.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We shall defeat the Voracity and win the Phantasmoon Games!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: And so, as your referee, I hereby declare: The curtain will not fall on this game until the husk is vanquished!
rows.speaker: Evanescia

rows.text: The actors have taken the stage, the cameras are rolling, and everything is set. My friends in the audience...
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Please enjoy this {RUBY_B#Arcadian Calendar Year 1999}end-of-the-century{RUBY_E#} magic trick, co-starring gods and mortals alike!
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: The gaze of the stars will converge on a single point.
As the legends state, eight Actors gather beneath the moon.
The Phantasmoon Games have commenced once more!
Now, let me formally introduce...
Aha's proxy...
And I, the magician's assistant...
"Remember? More than a fleeting minute, the winner of these Phantasmoon Games shall become the true, permanent Aeon of Elation."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: "Aha didn't lie. But the real answer... is going to blow your minds."
rows.speaker: Nihilux

rows.text: Good timing. What's our status?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Every attempt to contact Pearl has failed. That ship has clearly sailed into a different plane of existence.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: It lines up with the records of the Swarm Disaster. They call it... {RUBY_B#where gods wager}"time where only gods exist."{RUBY_E#}
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Which means there's no need for any further verification. Right now, the one steering the gondola really is Aha.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Every IPC employee knows the legend of the Swarm Disaster by heart. After all, it was the Amber Lord's hammer that put an end to it.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: In that chapter of history, there was also a gondola. It was packed with Fools, Mourning Actors, and various galactic factions, sailing through the stars and tipping the scales of an Aeonic war.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: But the funny thing is, Aha never once used THEIR divine power to protect the people on that gondola.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: As a gambler, I know firsthand that your payout depends on how much you're willing to wager.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: So whether we're talking about the past or the present, are the people on that gondola truly followers, or are they just chips pushed into the pot?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: You suspect Aha might not be on humanity's side after all?
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Well, I'm only keeping in mind what befits an Aeon.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Madam Jade, on my way here, I lost a little wager.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: A simple coin toss, outcome decided by luck. Usually, I only lose a toss if I want to.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: I sense a "but" coming.
rows.speaker: Jade

rows.text: Oh, it's worse than that. The coin split clean down the middle, no warning at all.
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Which leaves me wondering. Did someone or something "eat" my good fortune?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Or have we all been swept up in "chaos"?
rows.speaker: Aventurine

rows.text: Before the "time where only gods exist" arrives, let me tell you all one last joke.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: There was once an idiot who thought he could change the Elation, saving THEM and this entire Path from a pathetic end.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Yet deep within the remains of Oroboros, he saw the true face of the Voracity...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: A face... wearing the mask of Aha.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: The gondola has set sail, and the candies, mousse, and chocolate bars are all safely on board.
rows.speaker: Jerica

rows.text: ...What's the point? Everyone is going to die anyway.
rows.speaker: Dewide Chungus

rows.text: Dewide Chungus, what expired joke did you drink this time? Are you losing your mind again?
rows.speaker: Mocking Fool

rows.text: I'm perfectly lucid. I'm a monster wearing human skin, a half-eaten cookie, the mycelium of rotting dregs...
rows.speaker: Dewide Chungus

rows.text: We are all THEM... and we are all THEIR food...
rows.speaker: Dewide Chungus

rows.text: Hahahahahahahahaha!
Hahahahahaha!
rows.speaker: Echo of Primordial Laughter

rows.text: It's God! God is looking right at us! God is about to awaken!
rows.speaker: Dewide Chungus

rows.text: THEY will devour every single star! Devour, devour...
rows.speaker: Mocking Fool

rows.text: Eat the heads of Aha and Akivili! Terminus, who exists yet does not exist!
rows.speaker: Excited Actor

rows.text: Let's dance! Celebrate the funeral of Elation! The balloons are popping, the jokes are rotting, and desire will swallow reality whole!
rows.speaker: Crazed Actors

rows.text: Revel in it! The euphoria of primal desire will become the echo of the fourth Finality!
rows.speaker: Crazed Fools

rows.text: Wh—What's going on... What's happening to the Elation?
rows.speaker: Jerica

rows.text: The answer is...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Aha is long "dead."
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Oroboros killed THEM, then lay dormant for millennia to digest the Elation.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Or Aha won, but was driven by base instinct and assimilated with the Voracity.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Either way, it all led to the same outcome...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: A {RUBY_B#new Path}baby{RUBY_E#} is forming inside the leviathan's belly!
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: And that woman... Hey, wait a minute. Aha is already dead. I saw the crime scene with my own eyes.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: So... how could you possibly act in THEIR name, alongside humanity, to subdue the Voracity once again?
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: Haha... Perhaps we are all destined to witness the end of laughter...
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die

rows.text: A time of mourning, instead of euphoria.
rows.speaker: Asat Pramad's Die
